admission.justification: Publication of a freshly recomputed leaf knowledge worklist. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Publication of a freshly recomputed leaf knowledge worklist.
conditions: Byte-identical existing UTF-8 text is retained.
Missing, unreadable or different bytes are atomically replaced.
exclusions: This does not skip evaluation/currentness or turn an old worklist into an accepted verdict.
statement: Worklist evaluation still recomputes and verifies currentness, while publication keeps an identical text file and atomically replaces missing, unreadable or different bytes.
